items.content:
Turned $4M into $35M during COVID. Looking back, the trades were “stupidly obvious.” 

“There were like 20 big trades that I made over 90 days. I turned basically at the low point my account had dipped
 below $4 million and I in one year I turned it into 35 million, uh basically shorting the market on COVID and then 2 days after the market bottomed going massively levered long in all the companies that I knew were only going to benefit from CO.

Okay. And so like looking back, all of these trades were so unbelievably stupidly obvious that you could have been a middle school dropout and saw what I saw.

Like it's just like we're working from home. We're living outdoors. 

That's it. Like how is that going? You know, I always say as an observational social arbit trader, the more change, the bigger the opportunity. The faster the change happens, the bigger the opportunity.

We had never seen more change hit us so quickly in my lifetime than during that year of co. So that was the year for what I do.” 
Video

— @Nuel_Media Aug 1, 2026
